title: Good app, in-app transactions are messed up
body: They have an offer for 6,99 per year but when you try to activate it, it'll try to charge you 69,99 instead.
author: Necrogizer

title: Very useful!
body:
Amazing app, but can be improved in so many ways! 
1) Per instance, for habit “take medication” would be great if one could write the names of each medication and set reminders for each one. 
2) For habit “be thankful” to keep a small journal, easy accessible, of things one is thankful for. 
3) More than one reminder a day is also a must as well as an option to set specific hours for reminders.
4) Also please add an option to set reminder for something twice a month or specific days and not just the beginner/middle/end of the month.
Thank you!
